description: Options passed to the WYSIWYG JavaScript editing engine during initialization.

members.name: AccessibilityHelp
members.description: Screen reader help text announced by the editable surface.

members.name: Author
members.description: Current editing author used by JS-owned runtime revisions.

members.name: BodyLabel
members.description: Body label template. Use {0} for the one-based page number.

members.name: BodyPlaceholder
members.description: Placeholder shown when a document body page has no blocks.

members.name: EnableMutationGuard
members.description: Whether to enable the MutationObserver guard/fallback.

members.name: FontFamilies
members.description: Font families allowed for font family marks.

members.name: FooterLabel
members.description: Footer label template. Use {0} for the one-based page number.

members.name: FooterPlaceholder
members.description: Placeholder shown when a footer region is empty.

members.name: HasImageAssetOptions
members.description: Whether the host exposes provider-managed image assets that can be selected by the editor UI.

members.name: HeaderLabel
members.description: Header label template. Use {0} for the one-based page number.

members.name: HeaderPlaceholder
members.description: Placeholder shown when a header region is empty.

members.name: ImageAltMissing
members.description: Accessible warning text shown for images without alternative text.

members.name: ImageResizeHandleLabel
members.description: Accessible label for floating image resize handles.

members.name: ImageRetryLabel
members.description: Label for retrying a failed image load.

members.name: InsertPageBreakLabel
members.description: Label for the overflow action that inserts a page break.

members.name: InstanceId
members.description: Stable identifier for this editor instance.

members.name: PageLabel
members.description: Page label template. Use {0} for the one-based page number.

members.name: PageOverflowWarning
members.description: Status text shown when a page overflows its printable area.

members.name: ProtocolVersion
members.description: Schema version of the snapshot protocol.

members.name: ReadOnly
members.description: Whether the surface should be read-only.

members.name: ReviewDisplayMode
members.description: How tracked changes should be displayed in the JS-owned surface.

members.name: SuggestionDeleteLabel
members.description: Accessible label used for deletion suggestion decorations.

members.name: SuggestionInsertLabel
members.description: Accessible label used for insertion suggestion decorations.

members.name: TableCellPlaceholder
members.description: Placeholder shown when a table cell is empty.

members.name: TrackChangesEnabled
members.description: Whether the JS surface should render live track-changes decorations.

members.name: TypingBatchMs
members.description: Debounce interval in milliseconds for typing batching.
